notes: Source job identities and endpoint targets were captured from read-only live Lovable cron inspection. Raw cron command bodies are intentionally not stored because they may embed credentials. Source schedules must be re-captured from a validated export or successful read-only query before any source job is approved for target activation. Recovered live source code is evidence, not approved target code: truth-floor/auth/portability review is required before activate/replace decisions.

jobs.evidence_note: Live source implementation recovered. Depends on missing shared cron-guard/cron-batch/outcome-direction helpers and older cron secret conventions. Its prediction_accuracy_score is a deterministic outcome-fit score; do not treat it as calibrated probability without explicit semantics/evaluation.

Live source implementation is materially safer than historical random-outcome calibration: it restricts calibration input to prospective evaluated outcomes. Still depends on missing cron helpers, calibrates confidence against derived prediction_accuracy_score, and optionally calls the Lovable AI gateway. Requires provider-neutral/auth/epistemic hardening before port.

Canonical retention worker uses trusted-worker auth and a fixed category/table allowlist, validates retention_days, deletes only under explicit auto_cleanup policies, never touches audit logs, does not infer next_scheduled_at, does not mix in stuck-dataset lifecycle mutations, and does not mark a policy enforced when any target deletion/status update fails. Live source currently has zero retention policies; source schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.

Canonical morning brief preserves executive-recipient delivery and observed decision/advisory/signal counts behind trusted-worker auth, removes stale Quantivis/Lovable branding and hard-coded destination URLs, withholds delivery when explicit provider configuration is missing, checks provider HTTP success, uses daily recipient idempotency keys, escapes advisory content, labels high-severity signals accurately, and omits legacy calibration scores rather than presenting derived scores as confidence/probability. Exact source schedule remains unproven and no scheduler activation was added.

Canonical health-check preserves database, Auth, Storage, cron-run, execution-engine and Edge runtime probes behind trusted-worker auth. It no longer treats no execution observations as healthy, does not apply a universal cron staleness rule while exact schedules are unproven, and labels latency/error thresholds as configured operational thresholds rather than empirically validated SLOs. Storage health is explicitly control-plane only, not object-byte integrity. Source schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.
Command preview showed a CTE beginning with intelligence-brief-generator; full multi-call behavior must be recovered before classification.

Live engine owns fusion clusters, pressure models, conflict detection, attention budgets, memory and suppression. It also manufactures confidence defaults/composites (including fallback confidence values and historical reliability defaults). Canonical narrative-clustering is safer but functionally narrower and not an equivalent replacement.

Canonical builder preserves deterministic graph structure with explicit semantics, leaves analytical confidence/validation unknown when unmeasured, avoids causal claims for heuristic links, and uses trusted-worker auth. Source schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.

Canonical topology worker removes missing-value 0.5 fallbacks and historical_accuracy=50, excludes confidence from deterministic traversal weighting, withholds unmeasured evidence/stability/consistency/reliability/accuracy fields as NULL, labels structural scores deterministic heuristics, uses the canonical trusted-worker auth contract with no source-only helper dependency, and converts prior escalation assertions into heuristic-threshold events requiring governed interpretation. Source schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.

Canonical attention worker preserves bounded persona budgets and deduplication while treating topology inputs strictly as deterministic heuristics. Missing weighted input coverage is withheld rather than defaulted to zero; priority_score is explicitly a deterministic attention-ranking score, executive categories are labeled heuristic attention categories, and outputs deny calibrated probability/confidence/verified severity semantics. Source schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.

Canonical implementation preserves recurrence evidence while writing historical_effectiveness=NULL, effectiveness_semantics=unmeasured_no_outcome_linkage, pattern_semantics=deterministic_recurrence_pattern_not_causal_inference, and uses requireAdminOrTrustedWorker. No target schedule or writer activation has been added; live schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.
